```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Import the text file into a dataframe
pats37 <- read.delim("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Metadata/Raw_metadata/Data_matrix_37_patients.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pats37_daily <- read.delim("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Metadata/Raw_metadata/Data_matrix_37_patients_per_day.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pats30 <- read.delim("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Metadata/Raw_metadata/Data_matrix_30_patients.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pats30_extra <- read.delim("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Metadata/Raw_metadata/Data_matrix_30_patients_additional.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

mapping_forward <- read.delim("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Figshare_Linking/mapping_file_Forward.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

mapping_rev <- read.delim("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Figshare_Linking/mapping_file_Reverse.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

samples <- read_csv("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Ingham2019/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_samples.csv")
```

```{r}
patterns <- c(
  run_ERR     = "ERR[0-9]{6,}",
  run_SRR     = "SRR[0-9]{6,}",
  run_DRR     = "DRR[0-9]{6,}",
  biosample   = "SAM[END][A-Z]?[0-9]+",
  sra_sample  = "[EDS]RS[0-9]{6,}",
  experiment  = "[EDS]RX[0-9]{6,}",
  bioproject  = "PRJ[EDN][A-Z][0-9]+"
)

hits <- lapply(names(pats30_extra), function(col) {
  vals <- as.character(pats30_extra[[col]])
  found <- sapply(patterns, function(p) any(str_detect(vals, p), na.rm = TRUE))
  if (any(found)) data.frame(column = col, matched = paste(names(patterns)[found], collapse = ", "))
}) %>% bind_rows()

if (nrow(hits) == 0) message("No accession-like values found in any column.") else print(hits)

# --- (b) Look at the likely join keys ---
head(pats30_extra$feces_sample, 20)
head(pats30_extra[, c("Patient_ID", "days_posttransplant", "timepoint", "sampling_date")], 20)

# unique counts help tell you the granularity (sample-level vs patient-level)
sapply(pats30_extra[, c("feces_sample", "Patient_ID", "timepoint")], function(x) length(unique(x)))
```

```{r}
url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/filereport",
              "?accession=PRJEB25221&result=read_run",
              "&fields=run_accession,sample_accession,secondary_sample_accession,",
              "sample_title,sample_alias,library_name&format=tsv")
ena <- read.delim(url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(ena)  # inspect sample_title / sample_alias — that's what feces_sample likely matches
```

```{r}
samples2 <- samples %>%
  left_join(ena, by = c("Library Name" = "sample_alias" ))
```

```{r}
samples3 <- samples2 %>%
  left_join(pats30_extra,
            by = c("sample_title" = "feces_sample"))%>%
  mutate(`sample-id` = Run)%>%
  select(
    `sample-id`,
    Run,
    run_accession,
    sample_accession,
    Experiment,
    secondary_sample_accession,
    external_id,
    `Library Name`,
    sample_title,
    Patient_ID,
    days_posttransplant, 
    timepoint,

    Cell.dose.kg,

```

```{r}
ingham_meta_qiime <- samples3 %>%
  select(-timepoint)%>%
  mutate(transplant_type = case_when(
    `sample-id` == "ERR2666891" ~ "BM_UC",
    Bone.marrow == 1 ~ "BM",
    Peripheral.blood ==1 ~ "PBSC",
    Ubilical.cord == 1 ~ "UC"
  ))%>%
mutate(gvhd_prophylaxis = case_match(GVHD.Prophylaxis,
                                     1 ~ "Cyclosporine A",
                                     2 ~ "Cyclosporine + Corticosteroids",
                                     7 ~ "Cyclosporine A + Methotrexate"))%>%
  mutate(sex = case_when(Sex == 1 ~ "male",
                         Sex == 2 ~ "female",
                         TRUE ~ NA))%>%
  mutate(death = 1- Alive...1.yes..0.no.,
         tx_death  = 1- Sens.1.rel..now.0.death_remiss.,
         relapse  = 1- Sens.0.relapse.1.death.Now.)%>%
  select(`sample-id`,
         library_name = `Library Name`,
         sample_title,
         patient = Patient_ID,
         diagnosis_date = Date.of.diagnosis..dd.mm.yyyy.,
         transplant_date = Date.of.BMT..dd.mm.yyyy.,
         sampling_date, 
         timepoint = days_posttransplant,
         sex = Sex,
         age = Rec.age.in.y,
         weight = Weight,
         transplant_type, 
         donor = Donor,
         match = DonorMatch,
         disease = DiseaseNameIBMTR,
         gvhd_prophylaxis,
         agvhd = X541GVHDoccur,
         agvhd_grade = X542MaxAGVHD,
         agvhd_date = X549Date,
         cgvhd = X593ChGVHD,
         death,
         tte_death = X.Alle..Survival.all.patients..to.death._Surv,
         cause_of_death = Primary.cause.of.death,
         tx_death,
         tte_tx_death = X.Alle..Death.in.remiss_Surv,
         relapse,
         tte_relapse = X.Alle..Relapse_Surv,
         censor = Surv.to.now
         )
```
